CAD_BASE_URL.description: The address of your ctrl alt doc site, for example `https://docs.example.com`.

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: Your Discord application's **Application ID**, from the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) → General Information.

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Your application's **Public Key**, from General Information. Used to verify that requests come from Discord.

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Your bot's token, from the **Bot** page (select **Reset Token**). Used to keep the slash commands up to date.

BRAND_SETTINGS.description: Stores each server's settings, such as the embed colour.
